thread:
Jules (product): quick design pass: trace viewer drilldown — add a sticky correlation id, one-click copy, and decide where Download/Export lives on mobile. mock: https://redwood.mock/trace-ux-compact
Kai (design): uploaded small mock. Desktop: Download in header; Mobile: bottom sheet. Added 'Copy request id' chip and bolded filenames.
Sam (frontend): agree on chip label. make it a native button with `aria-label="Copy request id"` and `aria-live="polite"` toast on success. For download, stream response and disable button during download.
Rao (backend): streaming ok. big traces need trimming — server can return `trimmed:true` and a `original_length` field. propose cap at 5MB and show inline warning if trimmed.
Ava (a11y): a11y checklist: copy success must be announced via live region, copy chip must have 44px hit area and visible focus ring, chevrons need contrast >= AA (#374151). print view: single-column, avoid color-only cues.
design-bot: new token `--chip-touch-size` merged to staging (build 4350).
Kai (design): will update mock with larger hit area and contrast tweak, and change CTA label to 'Download trace (JSON)'.
Jules (product): plan: header download on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile, add copy chip, implement streaming/trimmed downloads. target canary next week. Ping thread when mocks/PRs are up. :thumbsup:
